name: Two people take turns
description: Needs --participants 3 or more. Expect the lines to alternate between Ada Lovelace and Alan Turing.

steps.text: Alan, did you get a chance to look at the latency numbers?
Yes. The median is under two seconds, but the tail is still too long.
Good. Let's focus on the tail next week.
Agreed. I will send a summary after the call.
